title: VS-Bonus
description: Plugin for applying bonuses to items.
body:
## 🔵 DESCRIPTION
Plugin for applying bonuses to items with full configuration.
## 🔵 FEATURES
- Applying bonuses to items
   - Damage bonus (Sword only)
   - Critical damage bonus (Sword only)
   - Health bonus (For each armor piece)
   - Durability bonus (For each armor piece and every tool)
   - Speed bonus (Boots only)
   - Bonus to the duration of positive and negative effects (Helmet only)
- Ability to configure the bonus application method via GUI or DRAG & DROP
- Intuitive in-game configuration GUI
- Custom GUI layout configurable in files
- Custom messages configurable in files
- Support for **CustomModelData**
- Formatting support: **MiniMessage (Adventure API)**
## 🔵 PERMISSIONS
- **vs_bonus.admin** » Access to all plugin commands and features
- **vs_bonus.command.reload** » Access to the /bonus reload command
- **vs_bonus.command.settings** » Access to the /bonus settings command
- **vs_bonus.command.give** » Access to the /bonus give <player> <bonus> <amount> command
- **vs_bonus.command.apply** » Access to the /bonus apply command
## 🔵 COMMANDS
- **/bonus reload** » Reloads the configuration without restarting the server
- **/bonus settings** » Opens a clear and user-friendly plugin settings GUI
- **/bonus give <player> <bonus>** » Gives the item required to apply a bonus to an item
- **/bonus apply** » Opens a GUI where a bonus can be applied
## 🔵 BUG REPORTS
If you found a bug or need help with the configuration, join our Discord server.
